crop.notes: Long sporting column (baseball editorial, Fairview yearling sale, rowing regatta, Daily-Casey fight, Billy Madden elopement, Irish athletic entries, billiards, tennis). Only the three-line 'Sporting Notes' item at the bottom of crop-5 is about Allen; crop-6 is the start of 'Minor Criminalities'.

ocr.notes: Allen notice gist is right but garbled ('M ALLEN', 'Pree Commeese aes'); the rest of the column is rough in places.

title.suggested: Notice of free concerts at Tom Allen's, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with free concerts every evening and only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, July 16, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: In July 1892 Allen's place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised free concerts every evening; he styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Same recurring notice as 853. Focus suggested primary because the item itself is entirely about Allen; 'passing' also defensible.
